comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for dangerous-command patterns. Consumed by BOTH the TS adapter (src/adapters/sandbox/dangerousCommands.ts, read at load via fs) and the Rust kernel (crates/omni-core/src/sandbox.rs, read at build via build.rs -> generated const). Both sides normalize a command identically (lowercase + collapse whitespace + strip spaces around '|') and match via case-insensitive substring containment. To change a rule, edit ONLY this file; never hand-edit the two consumers independently (that dual-table drift is exactly what audit item #18 fixes).
